title: Solar Cooker
guideExplore: Tilt the reflector to focus sunlight on the pot — temperature rises when alignment is good.
guideAligned: Well aligned — concentrated rays heat the pot quickly.
guideMisaligned: Misaligned — most sunlight misses the pot and heating slows.
conditionsHint: A parabolic reflector concentrates sunlight onto the pot when its tilt matches the sun.
quizQuestion: A solar cooker heats food mainly by…
quizCorrect: Concentrating sunlight with a reflector onto the pot
quizWrong: Burning fuel inside the reflector dish
learnMore: Alignment matters: when the reflector faces the sun correctly, focus intensity rises and the pot cooks faster.
